title: X-RIC: An Agentic RAN-Intelligent Controller Benchmark for Enhancing Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22269v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The O-RAN ALLIANCE introduces architectural flexibility through disaggregation and AI-driven control. While the RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) enables centralized optimization, current AI approaches lack reasoning capabilities and explainability. We propose eXplainable RIC (X-RIC), a novel framework integrating agentic AI into O-RAN architectures. X-RIC combines reactive Reinforcement Learning (RL) with strategic agentic reasoning through: (i) automated Behavioral Cloning (BC) using domain heuristics for sample-efficient training, (ii) a Telecom Language Model (TLM), a transformer-based reasoning module providing contextual abstraction and interpretability, and (iii) closed-loop co-adaptation within the Near-RT RIC control loop enabling continuous policy refinement. To ensure deployment readiness, we introduce BARX (Benchmarking Agentic Reasoning for RAN), a domain-specific evaluation framework assessing agentic control across latency,

translated_title: X-RIC：一种用于增强强化学习的智能体化RAN智能控制器基准
translated_abstract: O-RAN联盟通过解耦和AI驱动控制引入了架构灵活性。虽然RAN智能控制器（RIC）实现了集中式优化，但当前的AI方法缺乏推理能力和可解释性。我们提出了可解释RIC（X-RIC），这是一个将智能体AI集成到O-RAN架构中的新颖框架。X-RIC将反应式强化学习（RL）与战略性智能体推理相结合，具体包括：（i）使用领域启发式方法的自动化行为克隆（BC），以实现样本高效的训练；（ii）电信语言模型（TLM），一个基于Transformer的推理模块，提供上下文抽象和可解释性；（iii）在Near-RT RIC控制循环内的闭环协同适应，实现持续的策略优化。为确保部署就绪性，我们引入了BARX（面向RAN的智能体推理基准测试），一个特定领域的评估框架，用于评估智能体控制在延迟等方面的表现。
tldr: 提出了X-RIC框架，通过将智能体AI推理与强化学习相结合，引入电信语言模型（TLM）和闭环协同适应机制，显著增强了O-RAN架构中RAN智能控制器的推理能力和可解释性。
en_tdlr: X-RIC integrates agentic AI reasoning with reinforcement learning in O-RAN architectures, featuring a transformer-based Telecom Language Model and closed-loop co-adaptation to enhance the reasoning capabilities and explainability of the RAN Intelligent Controller.
